subject: Lakeshore: Post-incident technical brief and action plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@lakeshore.ai>, procurement@lakeshore.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lakeshore: Post-incident technical brief and action plan

Hi Elena / Lakeshore procurement team,

Thanks again for your patience this morning while we investigated the brief inference degradation you observed between 07:05–07:27 PT. We understand the impact on a live model evaluation pipeline and want to share an initial technical brief and the next steps we are taking.

Summary (short):
- What happened: a controller update triggered an unexpected memory-pressure interaction in the batch scheduler leading to elevated tail latency and a small fraction of 5xxs for routed requests.
- Scope: 11:05–11:27 UTC (approx) affecting your US region traffic only; ~0.8% of requests received degraded responses or 5xx status.
- Customer impact: delayed model responses and a handful of failed inference calls in production evaluation runs.

Attached: a concise RCA draft (lakeshore_rca_summary_v1.pdf), the request timeline we used for analysis (evidence-timeline.csv), and a short mitigation playbook we will push to production (mitigation-playbook.md).

Immediate next steps we will take in the next 48 hours:
1) Roll back the controller change that surfaced the issue (complete).
2) Deploy a scheduler patch with additional memory guards and a hard cap on in-flight KV cache allocations (ETA: 2028-06-15 02:00 UTC).
3) Add request-level retry instrumentation and a temporary traffic-split to a vetted model variant to avoid further customer-facing 5xxs (ETA: 2028-06-15 04:00 UTC).

We want to align on two asks from you: a convenient time for a 30-minute technical readout (we suggest Mon 06/16, 9:00–9:30 PT) and confirmation if you’d like a joint evidence review with your security/compliance lead.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short confirmation and a meeting invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

---
Attachment: lakeshore_rca_summary_v1.pdf (summary, 3 pages)
Attachment: evidence-timeline.csv (CSV, 1 file)

Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lakeshore: Post-incident technical brief and action plan

Ben — thanks for the prompt summary and attachments. We appreciate the transparency. A few quick clarifying questions before we book the call:

1) Can you quantify the number of failed inference calls we should expect to see in our historical logs?
2) Was any customer data exposed or persisted outside normal retention policy during the event?
3) For the rollback you mentioned, will that affect scheduled jobs we have running overnight?

We can do the technical readout Mon 06/16 at 9:00 PT. I’ll loop in our security lead if we need deeper evidence review.

—Elena
Elena Torres
Head of ML Ops — Lakeshore AI
elena@lakeshore.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lakeshore: Post-incident technical brief and action plan

Ben / team — forwarding Elena’s reply. Quick notes for the readout and artifacts:

- Quantify failed calls: Rachel, can you pull the Lakeshore request IDs from 11:00–11:40 UTC and summarize counts by status code (5xx/429/200-degraded)? Include sample request IDs for Elena.
- Data exposure: Hannah — confirm that no payloads were written to any off-cluster stores and that logs retain only hashed request IDs per our retention policy. Provide a short statement we can share.
- Rollback impact: Ben — confirm rollback was limited to the controller pod group in the us-west cluster; scheduled nightly jobs should be unaffected but we should verify.

I’ll join the call Monday. Ben, can you draft the calendar invite and include the evidence folder link and the JIRA ticket (JIRA-8123)?

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@lakeshore.ai>, procurement@lakeshore.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Lakeshore: Post-incident technical brief and action plan

Elena — following the internal confirmation from the ops team, please find the consolidated answers below and the updated attachments in the shared Drive link. We’ll cover all of this on the call Monday.

Consolidated findings (concise):
- Observed counts: 157 failed calls (5xx) and 412 requests with elevated latencies out of ~68,400 requests routed in the window (11:05–11:27 UTC). We’ve exported those request IDs and a short sample in evidence-timeline.csv.
- Data handling: No customer payloads were written to any external storage. All logs respect our retention masking policies — request payloads are never stored in plaintext. Hannah has attached a short assurance statement.
- Rollback impact: The rollback was limited to the controller rollout group; no scheduled jobs or persisted jobs were impacted.

Planned mitigations (completed or scheduled):
- Controller rollback (completed 2028-06-14 09:30 PT).
- Scheduler patch (will deploy 2028-06-15 02:00 UTC) adding per-request memory caps and backpressure heuristics.
- Traffic-split to vetted model variant + retries (will deploy 2028-06-15 04:00 UTC).
- Post-deploy verification run: we will execute an internal replay of your evaluation workload and share results within 6 hours of the patch deployment.

Attachments updated: lakeshore_rca_summary_v1.pdf (v1 -> v1.1 notes), evidence-timeline.csv (sample exported request ids), mitigation-playbook.md, assurance-statement-hannah.txt

Calendar invite: Mon 2028-06-16 09:00 PT — invite sent; meeting link and Drive folder included.

Thanks — we’ll walk through the timeline and the mitigation plan on Monday and follow with a written closure packet and a post-deployment verification report.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
